job.question: Which due diligence questionnaire in the corpus asks the manager 'What kills a deal for your team?', and who published it?
job.expected_facts: The Private Markets Due Diligence Questionnaire ('Your Resource for Evaluating Private Market Partners') published by Calamos Investments with Aksia (file AC_Private_Markets). The question appears under General Questions > Investment Strategy and asks the manager to describe a recent example.
job.acceptance: AC Private Markets / Calamos with Aksia accepted. Subtitle, copyright year and recent-example follow-up are optional.

reviews.reason: This is INREV’s questionnaire for non-listed real estate investment vehicles, not the specified Private Markets questionnaire. It does not contain the quoted deal-killing question or identify Calamos Investments and Aksia as publishers.
quotes: The Due Diligence Questionnaire (DDQ) for Non-Listed Real Estate Investment Vehicles, originally launched in April 2007, assists an investor or consultant in determining, in principle, whether a proposal fits the investor’s investment objectives.
INREV and its members do not take any responsibility for the completion or any corrections of this questionnaire.
